patch_description:
Replace the burst velocity tracking (which regressed from 2182.27 to 2005.09) with a working set stability score that samples recently-accessed folios within the protected window during eviction. If >80% of sampled folios show recent access (within 100ms), lower the hot access threshold by 1 to be more protective of the working set. This data-driven approach keeps thresholds well-calibrated as working set size and access patterns shift across workloads.

Changes:
1. Remove burst_velocity_map and related burst velocity logic (regressed performance)
2. Add a simple pass in eviction to sample folios and measure working set stability
3. Track a stability counter that feeds into dynamic hot threshold calculation
4. Lower HOT_ACCESS_THRESHOLD by 1 when stability >80%, otherwise keep it normal
